mentions.name: OnlyUsedTesla
mentions.description: OnlyUsedTesla is a marketplace/network for buying used Teslas that earns a 1% buy fee whenever a dealer in its network purchases a Tesla. It has generated some revenue and the builder is continuing to work on it.
mentions.audience: Dealers who buy used Teslas through the network.
